chats.answer:
For the best plug-in solar inverter (also called a microinverter or plug-and-play solar inverter), the right choice depends on whether you're connecting solar panels directly to a household outlet or installing a conventional grid-tied solar system.

My top brands to consider are Hoymiles, Enphase, APsystems, and Deye.

One important distinction: Most microinverters are not approved to simply plug into a standard U.S. wall outlet, even if they come with an AC plug. They typically require a code-compliant grid connection.
